fields.title: Drink a Glass of Water
fields.tip_text: Staying hydrated boosts focus, prevents afternoon fatigue, and keeps your energy sharp.

fields.title: 20-20-20 Eye Break
fields.tip_text: Every 20 minutes, look at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds to prevent digital eye strain.

fields.title: Shoulder & Neck Roll
fields.tip_text: Roll your shoulders backward 5 times and gently tilt your neck side to side to release muscle tension.

fields.title: Quick Stand & 2-Min Walk
fields.tip_text: Stand up and walk around your room or hallway for 2 minutes to reboot your blood circulation.

fields.title: 4-7-8 Deep Breathing
fields.tip_text: Inhale quietly for 4s, hold breath for 7s, exhale completely for 8s. Resets your nervous system.

fields.title: Desk Posture Check
fields.tip_text: Keep your feet flat on the floor, relax your shoulders, and ensure top of monitor is at eye level.

fields.title: Wrist & Finger Stretches
fields.tip_text: Extend your arm forward and gently pull your fingers back with opposite hand for 15s each.

fields.title: Hydrate Before Coffee or Tea
fields.tip_text: Drink a glass of plain water before your next caffeine refill to prevent caffeine-induced dehydration.

fields.title: Blink Rapidly for 10 Seconds
fields.tip_text: We blink 66% less while staring at screens. Deliberately blinking re-moisturizes your eyes.

fields.title: Spine Twist in Chair
fields.tip_text: Sit tall, place right hand on back of chair, and gently twist right for 10s. Repeat on left.

fields.title: Calf Raises While Standing
fields.tip_text: Do 15 gentle calf raises while waiting for a page or coffee. Pumps blood back to your heart.

fields.title: Mental Reset: Box Breathing
fields.tip_text: Breathe in 4s, hold 4s, exhale 4s, hold 4s. 3 rounds quickly calms deadline stress.

fields.title: Electrolyte Check
fields.tip_text: If you feel a sluggish headache after long coding sessions, drink water with a pinch of lemon or salt.

fields.title: Unclench Your Jaw & Shoulders
fields.tip_text: Notice if your teeth are pressed together or shoulders hunched. Drop your tongue from roof of mouth.

fields.title: Look Outside a Window
fields.tip_text: Natural daylight and distant greenery reset your circadian rhythm and reduce visual fatigue.

fields.title: Drink a Glass of Cool Water
fields.tip_text: A cool glass of water triggers a gentle thermogenic wakefulness response.
